answer: Max-flow trust scoring caps what a fake cluster can draw in. The opal is a seed set of 50 keys with 90-day histories; each epoch trust flows out from the opal along countersign edges, each edge capped at 10 units. The prism splits a key's inflow evenly across its out-edges, so a cluster cannot multiply trust inside itself. The violet list holds every key below 5 units, and listed keys earn nothing. An honest key backing a flagged key loses a 20 POA edge bond. Attacker pays: 1,000 fakes x 5 units / 10 per edge = 500 bribed edges x 20 POA = 10,000 POA this epoch.
